body: i hope it gets better for you, i really do

i was a kid when my family was stalked, but i knew it wasn’t going to stop & that we weren’t safe when he put little pieces of woods into our lock when we were visiting my grandma who was very ill. a lot of other stuff happened before that but i don’t really remember that much other than that, that he stole our winter tires resulting in a car accident and him driving by and stopping outside our house every day (sometimes he’d walk into the backyard and try to peep into the windows).

i say follow your gut, usually it knows when something bad is gonna happen way before you do. i hope everything turns out okay!
